unusable_reason: This video shows a two-leg squat filmed from the side, so it isn't possible to judge how your knee, hip and pelvis line up. Please re-record a single-leg squat on your right leg, filmed from the front with the phone at hip height, 2–3 m away, and your whole body from head to feet in frame.
summary: Thanks for sending this. The clip shows a two-leg squat filmed side-on, so the right knee and pelvis can't be seen from the front. That makes it impossible to rate knee drift, trunk lean or hip drop reliably. From this angle the squat looks smooth and controlled, with steady balance throughout. Please film again from the front while standing on your right leg only, keeping your whole body in view, and share it with your physio for review.
